objective: Bind asynchronous project-group expansion to the complete current browse scope and latest expansion intent.

source_candidate.task_artifact_commit: reported in terminal handoff; completion avoids recursive self-hashing

implementation.summary: A monotonic expansion intent and scope key bind view, filtered cohort/page, current cohort token, and stable group ID. Each awaited group page and every final member/card/error write checks the active intent. Browse navigation, Back/Forward, and need selection invalidate pending expansion; same-group reclick cancels it; newer group intent wins.

old_base_reproduction.test: late group expansion pages cannot restore members from a superseded browse filter
old_base_reproduction.failure: The stale old-scope response restored .project-members after the activity filter changed.
old_base_reproduction.restoration: PowerShell finally copied the guarded source back; byte hash matched.

retained_failures.notes: The manifest preserves exact hashes for captured focused-test failures and native Playwright artifacts. Two PowerShell construction errors stopped before app/test startup; their raw console bytes were not separately saved and are marked UNKNOWN in the manifest. The first token-fixture typecheck error and earlier browser fixture/assertion errors were corrected and retained.
